title: Blades in Phantom Blade Zero - Primary Weapon List
description: Blades are Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapons - Soul carries two at once. What is confirmed about the class, the full list of blades as it is verified, and how they interact with Phantom Edges.

sections.title: What Blades Are
sections.content:
Blades are the primary weapon class in Phantom Blade Zero. Soul carries two of them at the same time, alongside two Phantom Edges in the secondary slots - a 2 + 2 loadout rather than one weapon plus an off-hand.

Individual blade names, damage values and move sets have not been published. The demo build showed a pair of short swords together with a longer katana-class weapon, which is the shape of the choice: reach and speed trade against each other through the weapon itself, not through a stat line.

The secondary half of the loadout is Phantom Edges.

sections.title: Why Switching Matters More Than Which Blade
sections.content:
IGN observed in the 2024 demo that switching weapons refilled stamina immediately and let an ongoing combo keep running; the BWIKI combat page, written against 2026 footage, describes the same swap as refilling the Sha-chi bar and putting the outgoing weapon on cooldown. That single mechanic is why the combat reads closer to Ninja Gaiden than to a FromSoftware fight: the aggressive line is sustainable because the resource comes back on the swap.

Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and on blocking. Because both spend it, blocking everything runs the resource dry at the worst moment.

sections.title: How Blades Are Obtained
sections.content: S-GAME describes boss kills as rewarding unique weapons, which is the strongest published hint about where the roster lives. No drop table exists yet, so no acquisition route is asserted for any individual blade.
